parsed.note_claim: The Good Friday Agreement gives the UK Secretary of State for Northern Ireland power to call a border poll, including a duty if a majority for unity appears likely.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Secretary of State may by order direct the holding of a poll... the Secretary of State shall exercise the power under paragraph 1 if at any time it appears likely to him that a majority
parsed.reason: The text explicitly grants the Secretary of State power to order a poll and mandates exercising that power if a majority for unity appears likely.
